reason: I compare every AI tool on price per seat and default to free tiers; my small team fits in the first five free humans, so there is no reason to pay $30/seat/month for another layer to manage, especially with no Reddit or GitHub issues vouching for it.
objection: Another tool to manage — my team already has too many, and I won't pay per seat when the free tier covers us.
would_change_my_mind: Trusted peers on Reddit/GitHub actually using it in production, or a truly free tier with no seat ceiling.
